1.  Thyroid, total thyroidectomy:
              Papillary thyroid carcinoma, classic type.
              Tumor measures 1.2 cm in greatest dimension and is limited to the thyroid.
              Pathologic stage:  pT1b, pN1a, pMX.
              Two of six lymph nodes positive for metastatic papillary thyroid carcinoma
                      (2/6).
              All surgical resection margins free of tumor.
  
  2.  Central compartment tissue, excision:
              Two lymph nodes identified, all negative for metastatic carcinoma (0/2).

1. Thyroid
  2. Central compartment tissue
Specimen #1, received in formalin designated "xxxx" and
  "thyroid", is a total of thyroid that weighs 12 grams and is received unoriented.  The
  presumed right lobe measures 3.3 superior inferior, 1.8 medial lateral and 1.5
  anterior posterior; the isthmus measures 1.9 superior inferior, 1.3 medial lateral and
  0.6 anterior posterior.  The left lobe measures 3.7 superior inferior, 1.8 medial lateral
  and 1.5 anterior posterior with an attached yellow lobulated adipose tissue at the
  inferior pole that measures 1.7 x 1.6 x 0.7 cm.  The entire surface of the thyroid
  varies from dark-pink to pale-yellow at the isthmus area.  The entire anterior surface
  is inked blue, the posterior black and the anterior surface of the isthmus overlaid with
  orange ink.  The attached fatty tissue through the inferior pole of the lobe is also
  inked blue on its anterior surface and black on its posterior surface.  Prior to
  sectioning of the right lobe, the cut-surfaces demonstrate scattered colloid filled
  nodules that measure up to 0.7 cm in maximum dimensions.  The isthmus is
  sectioned from right to left and the cut-surfaces appear dark-pink and homogenous.
   Sections of the left lobe demonstrate a white dense predominant nodule extending
  from the lower inferior to most of the mid portion of the thyroid lobe and this nodule
  measures 1.2 x 1.0 x 0.8 cm.  At the attached fatty area of the inferior pole of the left
  lobe dark-pink scattered homogenous thyroid parenchyma is noted.  Representative
  sections are submitted as follows:
  
       1A:            Superior pole.
       1B-1C:      Intervening representative mid sections.
       1D:            Inferior pole.
       1E-1F:      Right to left representative sections of the isthmus.
       1G:            From the left lobe.
       1H-1I:        Sections demonstrating the predominant white and dense nodule.
       1J:             Additional sections from the inferior of pole of the left lobe.
       1K:            Most inferior pole of the left lobe.
       1L:            Additional sections from fatty tissue attached to the inferior pole of the
                              left lobe.
  
  Specimen #2, received in formalin designated "xxxx" and "central
  compartment tissue", is an irregular and rubbery nodular unoriented tissue
  measuring 1.8 x 1.1 x 1.0 cm.  It appears dark-pink to pale-yellow cauterized and
  nodular.  The entire surgical margin of the specimen is inked green.  The entire
  specimen is sectioned and the cut-surfaces demonstrate primarily yellow-lobulated
  cut-surfaces with focal pink and tan areas possibly thyroid parenchyma.  The
  specimen is totally submitted in cassettes 2A-2B.
Microscopic examination is performed on multiple sections, 14 slides in total.
History - History of left thyroid papillary thyroid carcinoma diagnosed on previous FNA (23-28
  -250). (BS/cn)

Clinical Information: Adrenal gland received in formalin. Specimen integrity: Intact. Dimensions of specimen: 10x9.5x7 centimenters. Perineural invasion: Not identified. Lymph-Vascular Invasion: Small vessel (capillary lymphatic). Microscopic Tumor Extension: Capsular invasion and sinusoidal vascular invasion identified.  HS:Adrenal01
